_readme: No keys or RPC URLs with API keys belong in this file. 'verified' notes say how each address was checked (rpc = on-chain read on 2026-10-01; web = cited page; repo = repo test config). Omitted keys are unknown and read as address(0) by the deploy scripts; see 'todo'.
name: base

weth.verified: rpc: symbol WETH, 18 dec; OP-stack predeploy

usdc.verified: rpc: symbol USDC, 6 dec; matches repo BASE_USDC (Circle native)

mln.verified: rpc: symbol MLN, 18 dec; but no Chainlink MLN feed (repo BASE_MLN_ETH_AGGREGATOR is TODO) so MLN is not registered as a primitive

release.chainlinkStaleRateThresholdNote: 2 x the longest heartbeat among registered feeds (USDC/USD 86400s) = 172800s. The ETH/USD aggregator heartbeat was not found in the Chainlink directory; observed gaps (<=1232s) are well inside the threshold.

gasRelay.verified: repo config leaves hub/forwarder as address(0) TODO on Base; gas relay disabled

ethUsdAggregator.verified: rpc: description 'ETH / USD', 8 dec, fresh answer. Heartbeat NOT confirmed in Chainlink directory (observed max gap 1232s over 15 rounds)

primitives.verified: rpc: description 'USDC / USD'; heartbeat 86400s per Chainlink directory (observed max round gap 86428s)

sequencerUptimeFeed.verified: rpc: code present; Chainlink docs https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/l2-sequencer-feeds. Not read by Enzyme contracts; for the app/monitoring only

uniswapV3SwapRouter02.verified: rpc: code present, factory() and WETH9() read, selector b858183f present and c04b8d59 absent

paraSwapAugustusV6.verified: rpc: 24562 bytes of code; address per Velora docs

todo: UniswapV3Adapter calls the original SwapRouter exactInput (with deadline); Base only has SwapRouter02. Uniswap v3 swaps stay disabled until the adapter is patched (separate follow-up PR).
GSN relay hub / trusted forwarder: unknown, gas relay disabled.
MLN/ETH Chainlink feed: none; protocol-fee buyback not usable via a priced MLN.
